checkpoint_finding.rule: A future state is target-label-unexposed only when normalization, graphs, neighborhood features, coordinate convention, variance balancing, lambda, PCA, clustering, Harmony, and mappings are selected without held outcomes under the registered participant split.

input_eligibility.gse192741: Visium RNA and coordinates are structurally compatible, but four donors and unresolved hg19 annotation permit only technical fixtures.
input_eligibility.gse292268: CosMx RNA and coordinates are structurally compatible as a separate panel and resolution stratum, but donor joins are unresolved and four donors are underpowered.
input_eligibility.hra007511: Visium RNA could be used only after permission, participant and section joins, output rights, and runtime admission. H&E and adjacent-section MALDI are excluded from this lane.
input_eligibility.vu2025: Visium RNA could be used only after the DSA and participant map clear. No graph may span the four to five participants sharing one VLP array.

exposure_and_leakage_findings.native_fit: BANKSY computes neighbor features, standardization, PCA, and a partition using the supplied target observations. Its normal workflow is transductive.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.coordinates: First-order azimuthal features depend on coordinate orientation. Axis swap, reflection, rotation, unit scaling, and section concatenation are part of the model identity.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.graph: KNN and weighted neighbor graphs must be participant- and section-blocked. Overlapping coordinate ranges from concatenated sections can create impossible edges.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.selection: Lambda, K, variance balancing, PCA, Harmony, cluster algorithm, resolution or cluster count, and any ARI-guided selection must be fit on development participants.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.strict_lane: The upstream workflow does not expose a complete native frozen donor predictor. Any development-frozen transform and head is a separately specified benchmark adapter.

known_incidents_and_biases: The selected exact Python source is GPL-3.0, while the separate R implementation has custom academic-only terms. They are not interchangeable implementation or license identities.
The PyPI 1.3.5 upload preceded same-version source fixes affecting parameter alignment, plotting, and integer-lambda handling, so those artifacts are not admitted as the selected code.
Native feature computation and clustering are target-fitted and cannot be described as zero-shot held-donor prediction.
Coordinate orientation can change azimuthal components even when pairwise distances remain similar.
Joint Harmony correction across target samples is cohort-transductive.
BANKSY standardized features and partitions do not provide a count likelihood or new biological replicates.
remaining_blockers: Obtain a rights-cleared powered participant-linked spatial expression dataset, registered endpoint, transcript-native baselines, and external source.
Build the future environment from the exact selected Git commit rather than the stale same-version PyPI artifacts and freeze all transitive packages.

Register separate native-transductive and benchmark-defined strict lanes; freeze normalization, coordinate convention, graph, lambda, K, variance balancing, PCA, Harmony, clusterer, resolution, cluster number, and mappings on development participants.

Pass fixtures for participant-blocked graphs, coordinate rotation and reflection, integer and floating lambda behavior, held-label exclusion, deterministic seeds, node and section order, sparse memory, no-network rebuild, and output round trip through CPU SLURM after activation and campaign approval.
Resolve dataset and derived-output rights before releasing any feature matrices or partitions.
Hash every graph, coordinate transform, feature roster, fitted transform, partition, environment, and terminal disposition before selection.
interpretation: BANKSY is a strong future simple spatial comparator, but it is a target-fitted feature and clustering method rather than a pretrained or naturally inductive model. The exact Python commit is open under GPL-3.0, yet its same-version package output files are stale relative to selected fixes. With no active spatial task, powered source, or external hold-back, it remains deferred.
